title.en: Sources of data: primary and secondary

hook.en: You want to know how much pocket money students in your college spend on snacks. Would you ask them yourself or look for a report?
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ತಿಂಡಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ನೀವೇ ಕೇಳುವಿರೋ ಅಥವಾ ವರದಿ ಹುಡುಕುವಿರೋ?

body.en: Primary data are collected by the investigator for the first time, for the purpose of her own study, for example by interviewing households. They are original and suited to the purpose, but cost more time, money and effort.
body.kn: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಶೋಧಕರು ತಮ್ಮ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದು ಮೂಲ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ, ಆದರೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

narration.en: Primary data are collected by the investigator for the first time, for the purpose of her own study, for example by interviewing households. They are original and suited to the purpose, but cost more time, money and effort.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಶೋಧಕರು ತಮ್ಮ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದು ಮೂಲ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ, ಆದರೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

body.en: Secondary data have already been collected and processed by someone else, and are reused. Sources include published reports of the Census of India, the National Statistical Office, the Reserve Bank of India, newspapers and journals. They save time and cost but must be checked for suitability and reliability.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಬೇರೊಬ್ಬರು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ್ದು, ನಾವು ಮರುಬಳಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಜನಗಣತಿ, ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಒ, ಆರ್‌ಬಿಐ ವರದಿಗಳು ಇದರ ಮೂಲಗಳು.

points.en: Published sources: Census, NSO, RBI, government reports
Unpublished sources: records of firms and offices
Cheap and quick, but check before use

narration.en: Secondary data have already been collected and processed by someone else, and are reused. Sources include published reports of the Census of India, the National Statistical Office, the Reserve Bank of India, newspapers and journals. They save time and cost but must be checked for suitability and reliability.
narration.kn: ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಬೇರೊಬ್ಬರು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ್ದು, ನಾವು ಮರುಬಳಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಜನಗಣತಿ, ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಒ, ಆರ್‌ಬಿಐ ವರದಿಗಳು ಇದರ ಮೂಲಗಳು.

problem.en: Classify as primary or secondary for the person using the data: (a) a student surveys 50 shops on plastic bag use; (b) the same student quotes RBI data on inflation; (c) a newspaper reprints the student's survey results.

steps.en: (a) The student collected it first-hand: primary.
(b) RBI collected it: secondary for the student.
(c) For the newspaper, the survey is someone else's data: secondary.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify as primary or secondary for the person using the data: (a) a student surveys 50 shops on plastic bag use; (b) the same student quotes RBI data on inflation; (c) a newspaper reprints the student's survey results.

body.en: If you collected it yourself, it is Primary; if you picked it from a Shelf or a website, it is Secondary.

narration.en: Primary = Prepared by me. If you collected it yourself, it is Primary; if you picked it from a Shelf or a website, it is Secondary.

mnemonic.en: P = Personally collected, S = Someone else's

points.en: Census, NSO and RBI reports are major sources of secondary data.
points.kn: ಜನಗಣತಿ, ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಒ, ಆರ್‌ಬಿಐ ವರದಿಗಳು ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು.

points.en: Secondary data save time but must be used with care.
points.kn: ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಮಯ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು.

homework.en: Give two examples each of primary and secondary data you could use for a project on your town's market.

narration.en: Recap. Primary data are first-hand; secondary data are reused. Census, NSO and RBI reports are major sources of secondary data. Secondary data save time but must be used with care.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ನೇರ; ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮರುಬಳಕೆ. ಜನಗಣತಿ, ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಒ, ಆರ್‌ಬಿಐ ವರದಿಗಳು ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು. ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಮಯ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು.
